name: item-group
summary: A labelled list of Items, with a line between the rows, an optional numbering and a message when it has none.

properties.name: label
properties.description: A short label above the list that also names it for assistive technology, such as "Recipes". Without one the host names the list another way.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: divided draws a line between rows; plain draws none; outline puts the whole list in one bordered box.

properties.name: ordered
properties.description: The order matters: assistive technology says each row's place ("2 of 5") and the list is a numbered one.

properties.name: empty
properties.description: What to show in place of the list when there are no rows, such as "No recipes yet".

slots.name: items
slots.description: The Items. Each is one row of the list, so a screen reader counts them.

accessibility.name: Its label, with the count of rows ("Recipes, list, 3 items"); an ordered list also gives each row's place.
accessibility.keyboard: The group is not a tab stop. Each pressable row is its own tab stop, in order.
accessibility.web: A <ul> (an <ol> when ordered) named by its label or an aria-label, each Item wrapped in an <li>; with no rows and an empty message, the message replaces the list.
accessibility.apple: A container of OuroItems, with the label as the accessibility label of the group.
accessibility.windows: UI Automation ControlType.List named by its label, each row a ControlType.ListItem; the Items keep their own Invoke pattern.
accessibility.android: A collection (CollectionInfo with the row count) named by its label, each row a collection item; an ordered list adds each row's position.

slots.items: Braised short ribs, Lemon orzo, Miso soup

cases.person: The label "Recipes" above three rows with a hairline between each.
No rows: the words "No recipes yet" in muted text take the list's place.

windows.type: Ouro.UI.Windows.OuroItemGroup, a templated WinUI Control; not yet built

android.type: bot.ouro.ui.hx.OuroItemGroup, in Jetpack Compose (ourostack/ouro-ui-android); not yet built
